Tess (People Ops): Quick thread for Liam's onboarding (start Mon 6/21). Need remote I-9 verifier slot, BG check status, laptop shipping, and payroll setup. Who's picking up which?
Morgan (HR): I'll schedule the remote I-9 verifier. Liam, prefer passport or DL+SSN? Also sending W-4 + direct deposit links now.
Liam (newhire): Passport is easiest. Thanks! Also I live in a rural areaso shipping ETA might be slower.
IT-team: We'll tag for expedited shipping. Need confirmed shipping address and preferred OS image (macOS default unless noted).
OnboardBot: Background check vendor (ClearTrail) status: "initiated". Typical turnaround 24-72 hours. Automated reminders in 48h.
Amir (Hiring Manager): Please add Liam to eng-team and slack channels on day 1. No on-call for first month.
Morgan (HR): Remote verifier slots available Fri 10am PT or Mon 8:30am PT. Liam, which works? Also note verifier will ask to hold ID up to camera and complete Section 2.
Liam (newhire): Friday 10am PT works. I'll be on video and have passport ready.
Tess (People Ops): Action list: Morgan = book verifier (Fri 10am); IT = expedite laptop shipping + include QuickStart; Liam = complete W-4/direct deposit; Amir = confirm repo access on day 1.
IT-team: Shipping created. Carrier UPS, tracking 1Z999AA10123456784. Includes power adapter + QuickStart sheet. ETA Mon.
OnboardBot: Reminder set: if direct deposit incomplete in 3 days, notify People Ops and payroll.
Morgan (HR): BG check cleared. Welcome packet and benefits enrollment invite sent.
Liam (newhire): Completed direct deposit and W-4. See you Monday 680
